title: ContextPacket v1
description: Compiled context view for an in-flight task. Temporary, not memory-truth. Excludes irrelevant receipts/scars; surfaces contested ones. Has token budget and freshness envelope. ContextCompiler consumes TaskIR + actor + mission and emits this.

current_truth.description: Ref to canonical TruthPackets active for this task.

relevant_scars.description: Procedural scars relevant to the task.

task_context.description: Direct context for the task itself.

excluded_context.description: What was explicitly excluded and why.

contested_memory.description: Memory entries with conflict signals (RECORDED vs OBSERVED, multiple agents disagreeing).

provenance.description: Provenance trail for the context assembly itself.
